note: Snapshot of starter tasks from the working Control Centre. No current status, assigned ownership or approval is inferred. GitHub Issues become operational after an authorised import.

actions.title: Review and agree Charter and Code
actions.nextStep: Read drafts; record amendments.

actions.title: Agree Governance and numeric thresholds
actions.nextStep: Test voting and recusal scenarios.

actions.title: Record adoption and effective date
actions.nextStep: Hold founding meeting and minute vote.

actions.title: Assign six leads and named backups
actions.nextStep: Complete Roles and appointment records.

actions.title: Appoint three Governance members
actions.nextStep: Reserved vote; confirm conflict / replacement process.

actions.title: Establish primary and alternative report contacts
actions.nextStep: Test both inboxes and explain monitoring hours.

actions.title: Secure an independent appeal arrangement
actions.nextStep: Confirm three competent reviewers and confidentiality.

actions.title: Train moderators and run three scenarios
actions.nextStep: Record lessons; resolve failures before invitations.

actions.title: Confirm responsible holder, jurisdictions and privacy notice
actions.nextStep: Obtain necessary advice and fill every live field.

actions.title: Set up named account access, MFA and recovery
actions.nextStep: Verify access and recovery without sharing secrets.

actions.title: Separate member, steward and casework storage
actions.nextStep: Test ordinary member and conflicted-founder access.

actions.title: Confirm membership / adult-only launch rules
actions.nextStep: Record the actual eligibility decision.

actions.title: Create the sixteen channels and pin conduct routes
actions.nextStep: Use Channels; no regional or duplicate groups.

actions.title: Adopt publishing tiers and reviewer rota
actions.nextStep: Test a Green, Amber and Red item without publishing.

actions.title: Choose live master locations and repair cloud links
actions.nextStep: Open links in an ordinary member account.

actions.title: Approve a limited pilot invitation
actions.nextStep: Verify all mandatory gates and record go/no-go.

actions.title: Hold the 30-day pilot review
actions.nextStep: Set date, collect feedback and publish changes.

actions.title: Track the six-month / 50-member election trigger
actions.nextStep: Keep minimal roll; begin preparation at 30 active members.

actions.title: Decide whether money-related activity is needed
actions.nextStep: Keep disabled until currency, approvals and obligations are settled.

actions.title: Assess any in-person or higher-risk event
actions.nextStep: Do not offer unsupported activities.

actions.title: Test backup restoration and steward handover
actions.nextStep: Record check and next quarterly review.

actions.title: Adopt retention review rules and access reviews
actions.nextStep: Check case-specific obligations and set review dates.
